description: Convert a document to Markdown (input ≤8MiB): docx, xlsx, pptx, pdf, html, csv, txt — md passes through; pdf text is extracted with pdftotext (≤500 pages): tables are linearized as layout text, and a scanned PDF without a text layer is rejected. Conventions: docx headings map to # levels, tables to Markdown tables, numbered lists flatten to bullets; each xlsx sheet becomes a ## section with its table (truncated at 200 rows); each pptx slide becomes a ## Slide N section; the filename extension routes the parser, so send the real file name

filename.description: File name with its real extension (e.g. report.docx) — the extension routes the parser

name: to_markdown
